_comment: Sim v2.1 protocol rev 1 gate, frozen BEFORE any rev-1 run (R-20261017-012 option 1). See PREREG_rev1.md.
static_ramp_candidates: all integers min_pods..max_pods (1..30), mean return on selection_seeds
pass_iff: mean paired return difference (threshold - static_ramp_best) > 0 AND lower end of the 95% bootstrap CI > 0
mean oracle replay return >= mean threshold return
reported_not_gated: preprovisioned fixed_best (c from the original preflight)

burned_seeds.1100-1109: first choice for the gate; evaluated by a smoke test (Codex review of 03832b4/b24b7e7), so burned and never used for the gate

terminal_backlog_rule: work still queued at the end of the episode is settled as failed (counted bad once), as in sim_v2/env.py
static_ramp_tie_break: smallest c among candidates with exactly equal mean return on the selection seeds
final_test_reservation: seeds 20000-20999 are untouched by rev 1 and reserved for the final evaluation
sensitivity_policy: gate is evaluated on the default config only; sensitivity configs are reported afterwards, descriptive and non-gating, for (a) the frozen controls and (b) controls re-selected per config on seeds 1000-1004
